name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on bench, grip bar wider than shoulder width. Lower bar to mid-chest, press up until arms are extended.

name: Barbell Back Squat
instructions: Place bar on upper back. Feet shoulder-width apart. Squat until thighs are parallel to floor.

name: Conventional Deadlift
instructions: Stand over bar, feet hip-width. Grip bar outside knees. Lift by extending hips and knees simultaneously.

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with bar at shoulder height. Press bar overhead until arms are fully extended.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge at hips, grip bar wider than shoulder width. Pull bar to lower chest, squeeze shoulder blades.

name: Pull-up
instructions: Hang from bar with overhand grip. Pull body up until chin is over the bar.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides. Raise arms out to sides until parallel with floor.

name: Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with palms forward. Curl weights up by bending elbows.

name: Tricep Dip
instructions: Grip parallel bars. Lower body by bending elbows to 90 degrees. Push back up.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold barbell at hip level. Hinge at hips, lowering bar along legs. Feel stretch in hamstrings.

name: Cable Fly
instructions: Stand between cable machines, grip handles. Bring hands together in hugging motion.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Set cable at face height. Pull rope toward face, separating ends. Squeeze rear delts.

name: Plank
instructions: Hold push-up position on forearms. Keep body straight from head to heels.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at machine, grip bar wide. Pull bar down to upper chest, squeeze lats.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat. Lift hips until body forms straight line from knees to shoulders.
